Bare your biceps and flex for everyone. The players next to you each drink 2 for the view.
All females drink 3, and all males drink 3. Equality.
Choose someone to drink with their non-dominant hand for the next round.

The person with the most expensive item on them takes 3 drinks.

The person with the longest beard takes 2 drinks.
Take a drink for each person with brown eyes in the group.
If you can touch your tongue to the tip of your nose give out 2 drinks, if you can’t take 2 drinks.
The person wearing the most buttons on their shirt takes 3 drinks. Mr Fancy aye.
The person with the most watches takes 2 drinks.
Give 2 drinks to someone, and serenade that person.
Play a round of categories, (your choice of the category) loser takes 2 drinks.
Give out 2 drinks for each double joint you have, take 2 drinks if you don’t have any.
Choose a player. You both stare at each other. First to blink takes 3 drinks.
Compliment the person across from you or take 2 drinks.
Reveal the last photo in your camera roll or take 2 drinks.
Everyone must speak in accents for the rest of the game. Anyone who forgets drinks.
Try to balance a drink on your head for 5 seconds. Take 2 drinks if you fail.
Whoever is wearing the brightest color gives out 3 drinks.
Whoever has the most unread notifications on their phone takes 3 drinks.
Everyone votes on the best-dressed player. That person gives out 4 drinks.
Everyone who has dyed their hair before takes 2 drinks.
Everyone show your lock screen. If it's a selfie, take 2 drinks.
Speak in rhyme until your next turn, if you fail take 2 drinks.
Everyone who has been on a plane this year takes 2 drinks.
Do 5 push-ups or take 3 drinks.
Don't use your phone until your next turn. If you do, take 3 drinks.
Everyone with blue eyes takes 2 drinks.
Whoever has the most battery percentage left gives out 3 drinks.
Whoever has the least battery percentage left takes 3 drinks.
Mention a player's name in every sentence until your next turn. If you fail, drink 2.
Try to lick your elbow. If you fail, take 2 drinks.
Swap an item of clothing with the person to your left or take 3 drinks.
Do a plank for 30 seconds or take 3 drinks.
Sing everything you say until your next turn. If you fail, take 2 drinks.
Keep your eyes closed until your next turn. If you open them, take 2 drinks.
Talk without closing your mouth until your next turn or take 2 drinks.
Try to touch your toes without bending your knees. If you fail, take 2 drinks.
